title: Crediting Relationship Bonus Left Unpaid by a Closed Statement Cycle
content:
Where relationship bonus interest stands owed on an account of Savings & Money Market Accounts for a statement cycle that has already closed, that bonus is settled on the account as a correction to that cycle.

A single relationship bonus interest entry is credited to the account, marked as a bank error correction and carrying the statement cycle it belongs to. The account's posted balance rises by the credited amount immediately, and the customer sees a new relationship bonus line dated today, carrying the corrected cycle, and a balance higher by that amount.

### Recording the correction

The correction is recorded with the tool `post_relationship_bonus_correction_5bb15040`. It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. One call posts one relationship bonus interest entry.

### Parameters

`savings_account_id` — the reference number of the savings or money market account the relationship bonus is credited to, taken from the savings account lookup.

`customer_id` — the customer reference number of the account owner, taken from the customer profile lookup.

`statement_cycle` — the statement cycle the unpaid relationship bonus belongs to, being the month in which that cycle closed. It is written as YYYY-MM, and an empty value is not accepted.

`bonus_amount` — the relationship bonus interest being credited, in USD to 2 decimal places, always positive. A value carrying more than 2 decimal places is stored rounded half up to the cent, and the bank's own Eastern Time posting date is used.

### What the call returns

A confirmation sentence carrying the reference number of the relationship bonus entry just created, the credited amount in USD to two decimal places, the statement cycle it was booked against, and the account's new posted balance in USD to two decimal places. That sentence is what indicates the credit completed.
